title: Modular Rack
author: user_860553965
description:
This modular rack is designed for strength and stability, with minimal moving parts. Its design is informed by FEM analysis and real-world testing.

A tight fit and hexagonal mating joints prevent the rack components from slipping apart. The structure is also designed with material efficiency in mind without compromising overall strength.

> FEM Analysis showing 3mm maximum displacement under 100 kg (980 N) load on both faces.
